Business Context and Use

The debt recovery score can be used to determine whether items of a business partner should be submitted to an external
collection agency or a legal dunnning system.

The inbound service operation Response Debt Recovery Score By Debtor Party can be used to update the debt recovery score for
the relevant business partners. The actual submission of the items can then depend on this debt recovery score.

Features

The inbound service operation Response Debt Recovery Score By Debtor Party updates the debt recovery score for the specified

business partner(s).

To determine the debt recovery score of business partners specify the business partner numbers.

Error Handling

Forward Error Handling

The inbound service operation Response Debt Recovery Score By Debtor Party uses Forward Error Handling (FEH) . The
classified error category is Determination & Conversion Error . In case of such an error, the entire inbound service operation fails
and no updates are executed. You can then repeat the processing or discard all information.
